simple.meaning: מִפְתָּח (miphtâch) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an aperture , i.e. (figuratively) utterance.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Chronicles 9:27. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִפְתָּח (H4669) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מִפְתָּח (miphtâch) / H4669 is traced through 1 Chronicles 9:27, Proverbs 8:6 with generated occurrence evidence.
